pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

2. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 0

3. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

5. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 40.5
   C. 81
   D. 10

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

8. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 15

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 42
   C. 90
   D. 30

10. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 11

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 17
   C. 34
   D. 22

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 31
   D. 17

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

18. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 16

19. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 6

20. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

22. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 25

25. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

26. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

27. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 37

28. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

29. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

30. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
